stem.text: In the circuit shown, an analogue ammeter is to be recalibrated as a thermometer. The ammeter is connected in series with a thermistor. The thermistor is a component with a resistance that varies with temperature. The graph shows how the resistance $R$ of the thermistor changes with temperature $T$.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a battery connected in series with an ammeter (A) and a thermistor. Printed label: thermistor.
Graph with vertical axis R/kΩ and horizontal axis T/°C, showing one curve. Printed tick labels on the T axis: 0 and 100.
